content.rationale: The wider-gate refusal is where the removal rule's orphaned-gate clause meets the refusal; the gate keeps the use sound without testing the scan itself. Its two edges span two cells — one prose parent (nat→structured) and one EARS parent (structured→structured, a default cell) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
